classification.difficultyReason: Each part links cumulative-table completion to two graphical constructions. Students adapt the taught boundary procedure to score spacings of 5 and 2, plot cumulative column heights and upper-boundary ogive points, and preserve a horizontal ogive segment at a zero frequency. These are routine linked procedures with supplied axes.

content.prompt: Complete the tables then construct a cumulative histogram and ogive.

spec.description: Editable axes and dashed grid without answer bars or ogive. No horizontal-axis title or arrowheads.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal ticks 0,5,10,15,20; vertical ticks 0 through 6. Grid intervals 2.5 horizontally and 0.5 vertically. The vertical axis lies at the first bar boundary, -2.5.
spec.answerVisibility: Blank construction scaffold authorised by reviewed-interpretations-p48.

answer.short: Cumulative frequencies: $1,\ 2,\ 4,\ 4,\ 6$. Histogram and ogive shown.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}C_1&=1\\C_2&=1+1=2\\C_3&=2+2=4\\C_4&=4+0=4\\C_5&=4+2=6\end{align*}$$
Draw touching columns of width $5$, centred on the scores, with these cumulative-frequency heights. Begin the ogive at $(-2.5,0)$ and join the upper-right corners $(2.5,1)$, $(7.5,2)$, $(12.5,4)$, $(17.5,4)$ and $(22.5,6)$. The zero frequency at score $15$ gives a horizontal segment.

spec.description: Five touching unfilled cumulative histogram columns with a blue ogive; original dashed grid and omitted horizontal-axis title retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete supplied graphical answer; answers only.

spec.description: Editable axes and dashed grid without answer plots. Horizontal title Score; vertical title Cumulative Frequency. No arrowheads.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal ticks 2,4,6,8,10,12; vertical ticks 0 through 9. Grid intervals 1 horizontally and 0.5 vertically, including an unlabelled line at 9.5. Vertical axis at first bar boundary 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Blank construction scaffold authorised by reviewed-interpretations-p48.

answer.short: Cumulative frequencies: $3,\ 4,\ 6,\ 6,\ 8,\ 9$. Histogram and ogive shown.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}C_1&=3\\C_2&=3+1=4\\C_3&=4+2=6\\C_4&=6+0=6\\C_5&=6+2=8\\C_6&=8+1=9\end{align*}$$
Draw touching columns of width $2$, centred on the scores, with these cumulative-frequency heights. Begin the ogive at $(1,0)$ and join the upper-right corners $(3,3)$, $(5,4)$, $(7,6)$, $(9,6)$, $(11,8)$ and $(13,9)$. The zero frequency at score $8$ gives a horizontal segment.

spec.description: Six touching unfilled cumulative histogram columns with a blue ogive and the source dashed grid.
